6.3.1.2.2 Memory Abstraction Interface
Detection Reported by the Flash Eeprom emulation (see Flash Eeprom emulation above), only if the stack is configured in polling mode. Reaction N/A Report Depending on the configuration:
 [MemIf043] [MemIf053] The error shall be polled by the NVRAM manager with the function MemIf_GetJobResult (job result set to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED). Recovery See NVRAM Manager.
